{{Top|leg}}
A '''landing shackle''', also known as a '''security shackle''', was a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] security device that was affixed to a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] landing gear at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to prevent it from launching. A landing shackle was used on the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Asaari Wind]]'' when it was berthed at [[Docking Pad P13]] at the [[Palisade starport]] on [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. After the [[Cecil Noone's crew|crew]] caused a commotion killing [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] on his [[Tyro Viveca's estate|estate]], the ''Asaari Wind'' attempted to leave the spaceport while the landing shackle was still attached. Initially, the craft's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] were not enough break the landing shackle's grip. Once the ship's [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] were engaged, the ''Asaari Wind'' broke free of the shackle but lost the landing gear the shackle was attached to alongside with structural girders, [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plates, and the entire aft repulsorlift unit.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
